claims.summary: The release is grounded in a fresh deployed v0.15.79 Project Management ZIP/log audit whose exported report reached 99/A with texture as the only scored remaining package loss.
Course FAQ variety repair now detects repeated checklist, prepared-response, concrete-evidence, and office-hours answer shingles even when FAQ questions are unique.
Repaired FAQ answers rotate deterministic lesson/topic/assessment-specific wording instead of repeating a single support scaffold.
The release carries forward the need for a fresh v0.15.80 deployed audit and does not claim the current-run local-storage quota warning is fixed.

carryForward.next: After deploy, run a fresh v0.15.80 EduTool.dev ZIP/log audit to verify provider output, export, texture, and UI caveats end to end.
Prune or rotate browser-saved conversation/workspace state so current runs do not emit QuotaExceededError.
